material.notes: codesearch rs-plugkit main git.rs for recurse-submodules / submodule update; if none exists, the limitation is reported and the patches are committed under a named path in gm-work
material.subject: gm-work's agentplug/ and gm-mcp/ submodule directories are empty and no git verb clones or initialises a submodule; which sanctioned verb (git_pull recurse? git_checkout?) can populate them so the source changes and pin bumps are committable
material.witness_evidence: precondition answered by exhaustive codesearch (regex `submodule update|recurse-submodules|submodule init|"submodule"`, exhaustive: true, 0 matches) over rs-plugkit origin/main a1b12de crates/plugkit-core/src/wasm_dispatch/verbs/git.rs: no git verb runs `git submodule update/init` or passes `--recurse-submodules`; git_pull, git_checkout and git_clone-free verbs never populate an empty submodule directory. The limitation stands as reported: an empty agentplug/ or gm-mcp/ cannot be populated through a sanctioned verb, so a change to those trees is committed in its own clone (e.g. /Users/dylanwong/dev/agentplug) and only the pin bump lands in gm-work. This session took that path for rs-plugkit: git_checkout {cwd: rs-plugkit, ref: origin/main} then git_checkout {ref: feat/git-amend-reword, create: true} inside the already-populated submodule.

material.subject: a scratch AGENTPLUG_HOME + GM_TOOLS_DIR with copied plugins and precompiled cache runs the built runner (daemon and spool modes) without touching ~/.agentplug, ~/.gm-tools or the registry the live daemon reads
material.witness_evidence: precondition discharged live (exec_js dispatch_id 1791922771057-173-e0f2957e59dc4a0e): AGENTPLUG_NO_DAEMON=1 AGENTPLUG_HOME=/tmp/agentplug-home-amend ~/.gm-tools/agentplug-runner dispatch gm git_status ran the locally built rs_plugkit.wasm copied to /tmp/agentplug-home-amend/plugins/gm.wasm with sibling plugins copied from ~/.agentplug/plugins; stderr '[agentplug precompiled] gm compiled to /tmp/agentplug-home-amend/precompiled/gm-d341d7938e69eede-d8a32130706ef6fd.cwasm (21 MB, 3257ms)' shows the precompiled cache landed under the scratch home, the reply was the real git_status of the scratch repo (head ac4f90974f4898085e9b6f2b0754c781e6e530f6), and ~/.agentplug/plugins/gm.wasm (sha unchanged, mtime 2026-10-08T10:02:02Z) and the live daemon (pid 2012 serving /Users/dylanwong/gm-work) were not touched. install.rs:3 install_dir() honours AGENTPLUG_HOME for plugins/, precompiled/ and wasmtime-cache/. Dispatch mode witnessed; spool/daemon mode not exercised by this session.
